name: Weed Snobs | 1.2g Diamond Infused Preroll | Ice Cream Cake
description: Ice Cream Cake is a indica dominate strain that is a cross between Gelato #33 and Wedding Cake. It has a sweet, nutty flavor profile reminiscent of baked goods. This strain produces mostly relaxed, happy and sleepy effects.
